input: Map out all my credit card due dates

gold.taskTitle: Map out all credit card due dates
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to organize and track the payment due dates across all their credit cards.

questions.title: How many credit cards do you currently have?
questions.description: Establish the total number of credit cards to be included in the mapping.

questions.title: Where do you want to store this due date map?
questions.description: Determine the preferred format or tool — spreadsheet, calendar app, notes app, paper planner, etc.

questions.title: Do you want due dates shown as fixed or rolling dates?
questions.description: Clarify whether due dates are the same each month or shift based on billing cycles.

questions.title: Do you want minimum payment amounts included too?
questions.description: Find out if the map should capture financial details beyond just the dates.

questions.title: Should each card's credit limit also be recorded?
questions.description: Determine if credit limit per card is relevant information to include in the map.

questions.title: Do you want reminders set before each due date?
questions.description: Establish whether the user needs automated alerts or notifications tied to the due date map.

questions.title: Is the goal to avoid late fees or to plan cash flow?
questions.description: Understand the primary motivation so the plan can be tailored to the right outcome.
